turns.q: Do you compensate for a long delay?
turns.replyTail:
don’t pre-approve compensation for shipping delays. If a delay affects the condition of your plants when they arrive, reach out to us right away and our team will review the order and help with next steps.

Our plants are prepared to handle normal transit conditions and short carrier delays, but if your package arrives and you have concerns, please contact us immediately with your order details. If you want, send me your order number and I can check the current status for you.
